sections.title: Morning Shift (06:35 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Commencing Delta Route. Welfare check on Starbucks, all clear. Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible.
Welfare check along McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check along Remedy Coffee, all clear.

Arrived at check in Aotea Square, full walkthrough completed around the area making sure no issues are present, checked on static guards, all clear. Standby to ensure our presence while waiting on further response calls.
Leaving station at Aotea Square and on route to next checkpoint.
Arrived at check in Top of Mayoral Drive, full scope of the location, all clear. Patrolling along Mayoral Drive towards corner of Cook and Federal Street.
Welfare check on convenience store nearby Cook Street and Federal Street, all clear. Patrolling down Federal Street now.
Scoping out the area of Auckland Council Building, no issues found.
Arrived at check in Top of Victoria Street, welfare checks commenced on all stores and businesses, no issues found. Standby for response calls while showing our presence.
Welfare checks completed along the corner of Kingston and Albert Street stores, all clear.
Welfare check along The Cathedral Church and Federal Square, walkthrough completed without finding any problematic issues.
Welfare check along Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.

Ending Delta Route. Commencing Alpha Route. Arrived at check in Corner of Customs and Albert Street Intersection, area has been thoroughly scoped out, no issues found. Heavy presence from members of the public.
Welfare check on Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Welfare check along OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Arrived at Queens Wharf, scoped out the area, no issues found.
Arrived at check in Commercial Bay, full walkthrough commenced along the area making welfare checks on all stores and businesses within the location, all clear.
Standby to show our presence due to heavy presence from members of the public and also waiting on response calls to arise.

Continuing our patrols due to no issues or concerns identified. Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible while also commencing check ups along the way for any safety concerns from stores and businesses.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks completed with no concerns identified.
Arrived at the corner of Shortland and Queen Street, no issues found.
Arrived at the corner of Queens and Wyndham Street, checked into Chemist Warehouse, Mac Pac, Kathmandu, SAP Building, Opsm, Spec Savers and Hallensteins, no issues reported.
Welfare check inside Canterbury Arcade, all clear. Welfare checks completed along Queen Street stores with no issues found so far. Ensured our presence is visible.
Arrived at HQ, taking a quick restroom break before continuing our patrols.

Response call from The Right Track, Fort Street. Reported a male individual refusing to leave the store after being asked by the store manager due to causing a disturbance inside the premise. Requesting assistance of removal from the property.

Arrived at response location, POI had already exited the premises. Heavy presence from street vagrants and suspicious individuals in the area. Huge group standing opposite of Joe and Jones near the public restroom. Will be on standby to show our presence here before continuing our patrols.
The huge group of individuals are coming in and out of The Right Track to play the pokies machine; so far the male individual that caused a disturbance has not tried to return.
Advised the store manager to keep us notified if he does return; we are now continuing our patrols.
Welfare checks completed along High Street stores, all clear.
Stopping by Wilson's Carpark at Kitchener Street to grab some documents from the car.
Arrived at HQ, heading up to Level 7, on standby for response calls and incidents to occur.
Arrived back at HQ Level 1 for a quick break.
Break completed, continuing our patrols now.
Commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses along Upper Queen Street while also keeping our presence visible and known.
Arrived at check in Aotea Square, full walkthrough completed, no issues found. Standby for response calls and incidents to occur.
Ending Alpha Route. Commencing Echo Route now.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at check in Corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, no issues found.
Welfare check along Acceco Supermarket, Sals Pizza, NZ Muscles and Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Arrived at check in Elliott Street Apartment, all clear. Patrolling through Elliott ensuring our presence is visible.
Arrived at check in Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne and High Street intersection, scoped out the area, all clear. Patrolling down High Street making quick check ins on all stores.
Welfare check along Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall, all clear.
Arrived at check in Chancery Square, full sweep completed within the vicinity, no issues found.

Arrived at check in Wilson's Carpark, group of suspicious individuals are still present, checked into all stores and follow up check on The Right Track, all clear. Checked in with the static guards for Prestige Security, all clear.
Arrived at check in Bottom of Fort Street, checked into all stores and businesses within the area, all clear. Standby to show our presence before moving along.
On route back to HQ due to Ops Phone running low and also to take lunch break.
Arrived at HQ, standing by to recharge the Ops Phone due to low battery, taking our lunch break now and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Afternoon shift deployed, having a little debrief before commencing patrols.
Received a response call from Ippondo Queen Street regarding vagrants outside of the store. On route to location.
Arrived at response location, kindly asked vagrants to move along, no further issues till vagrants moved along.
Standing down from response, commencing patrols down Queen Street.
Standing by maintaining our presence in the middle of Queen Street in case of a response call.
Spotted well known thief in the area, maintaining presence.
Received a call from Cotton On regarding 2 vagrants that have walked inside the premises scoping out the area but have left. On route for a welfare check (photo on file).
Arrived at Cotton On, manager has given us a description of the vagrant that is well known for stealing on site. Found vagrant outside the Sale Shop, approaching vagrant to never come on site again.
Vagrant has been notified of the matter and has complied to never enter. Maintaining our presence for any issues that occur.
Standing down presence, continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Full sweep Queen Street, welfare check on all businesses, all clear, no issues. Arriving at Britomart, commencing sweep.
Arrived at Britomart, commencing sweep in the area and maintaining visible presence.
Full sweep Commercial Bay, welfare check on all businesses open within the area, all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling through Customs Street East.
Standing down patrols for now; received a response call from Ippondo Queen Street regarding vagrants posted outside the premises. On route to response location.
Arrived at response location, approached vagrants posted outside the premises and asked nicely to move along, standing by till vagrants leave the site.
Vagrants have left the site (photo on file). Commencing sweep on Darby Street and Elliott Street.
Full sweep Elliott Street and Darby Street, welfare check on businesses open within the area, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Victoria Street West.
Full sweep Victoria Street West, welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check Federal Street, all clear, no issues. Arrived at St Patricks Sq, sweeping the area.
Welfare check Cathedral and Liston House, all clear.
Full sweep St Patricks Sq, welfare check on all businesses, all clear, no issues or heavy footwork in the area.
Welfare check bottom half of Federal Street and Fanshawe St, all clear. Patrolling through Customs St East.
Full sweep Customs Street East, patrolling down Fort St.
Welfare check Fort Street and Fort Lane as well as Gore St and all the businesses open, all clear. Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone.
Arrived at Headquarters, charging ops phone in office and responding to any response calls that occur (percentage will be shown on camera).
Floor checks completed, patrolling down Queen Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep lower Queen Street, welfare check on remaining businesses open within the area, all clear.
Welfare check Commercial Bay and businesses in the area as well as downtown waterfront, clear, no issues.
Welfare check Reign n Pour, no issues identified.
Full sweep Quay Street, welfare check on Danny Doolans, The Fox, Rosie's Hot Cantina, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Customs Street East to Albert.
Customs Street East all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Albert Street.
Welfare Albert Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Albert Street, Mayoral Drive full sweep, all clear, no issues to report. Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing sweep in the area.
Full sweep Aotea Square, not much footwork in the area. Continuing patrols down Lorne Street.
Welfare check Central City Library, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Lorne Mural Staircase, all clear, no issues identified.
Whole of Lorne Street all clear, no issues, welfare check on businesses in the area. Patrolling down High Street.

Standing down patrols. Received response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a little individual that was held at knife point for his belongings by a group of delinquents. Staff safely held the little individual inside the staff room until we arrived. On route to response location.

Arrived at response location; the individuals that held the little individual at knife point were already off premises and the little individual was hiding in the room due to his safety being at risk. He requested we escort him to his mother's location. Called the police to sort out this issue (photo on file).
Police have arrived, giving out statements and reports of the group of delinquents that caused this incident. Standing by at Commercial Bay for any police assistance needed.

Stand down assistance; police have gathered enough intel from us regarding the incident and have offered to escort the little individual to the mother's location. Continuing patrolling down to Fort Lane.
Welfare check Fort Lane and all businesses, all clear.
Welfare check Shortland Street and all businesses open in the area, all clear. Patrolling up High Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Freyburg Pl, commencing sweep in the area.
Full sweep Chancery Sq, Freyburg Pl, welfare check O'Connell Street and all businesses still open, all clear, no issues.
Whole of High Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Victoria Street West to Queen Street.

Welfare check Localito, McDonald's Queens, Avachi, Chacha, City Centre, 77 Convenience Store, Time Zone Centre and all other businesses open that have not been mentioned, all clear, no issues to report. Commencing sweep down Darby Street / Elliott St.
Arrived at Darby Street, commencing sweep in the area and identifying any risk.
Full sweep Darby Street, Elliott Street, welfare check on all businesses within the lanes. Heading back to HQ to commence 30 minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters, commencing break while responding to any calls that occur in the area.
Afternoon shift concluded, handing over to night shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Vest, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Keytags, 1 x Work Phone.

Standby in Commercial Bay for any near calls and showing our presence.
Continuing our route, patrolling up Albert Street.

Welfare check on Karaoke Bar, Sky Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Wellesley Street, Mayoral Drive, all clear.
Full sweep all around Aotea Square, all clear, no issues. Standby Aotea Square for any near calls and showing our presence.

Standby in front of Bar101 for any near calls and show our presence.
Welfare check Queen Street McDonald's, all clear, no issues.

Arrived at Bar101, approached the group of boys to move along and they complied and walked away without further issues.
Doing full sweep all around Freyberg area and Chancery Square, all clear, no issues.
Standby Freyberg Square for any near calls and showing our presence.
Patrol through O'Connell Street, bottom of High St, Fort St, White Lady, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Gore St, Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear, no issues. Beta Route complete.
Welfare check on Britomart, Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on carpark next to Chemist Warehouse, all clear, no issues.
Upper Queen Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Aotea Square, Mayoral Drive, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Customs St, Custom Mart Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Fort Lane, Fort St Jo & Joe, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on High St, High Street Supermarket, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Chancery Square, Freyburg area, Upper High Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Lorne St, Auckland Library, all clear, no issues. Delta Route complete.
Check on Darby St, Elliott Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling up Victoria St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Federal St towards Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling down Wyndham St towards Queen St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Q Convenience Store and Customs Mart, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort St, and the bottom of High St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on High St Supermarket, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep all around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear, no issues. Echo Route complete.
Welfare check on the bottom of Hobson St, all clear.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store on top of Victoria Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrol down Victoria St towards Queen St, Lorne St, all clear, no issues. Charlie Route complete.
Handover to morning shift. Night shift concluded.
